content: {"praised":["Humor was entertaining and made viewers laugh all the way through.","Steve Martin’s portrayal of Clouseau was praised as brilliant.","The film was described as a funny comedy with great laughs.","The movie provided pure entertainment for 93 minutes.","The character of Clouseau was seen as a new creation by Martin."],"criticized":["Acting was described as non-existent and poor.","The film was called garbage and bad by reviewers.","Clouseau’s character was criticized as poorly written and effeminate.","The movie was said to be so bad it made Ishtar look like an Oscar winner.","The humor was deemed ineffective and lacking by some viewers."]}
